'''Shimmerbirds''' were creatures whose [[Tongue/Legends|tongues]] were harvested for [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="AOTCVD" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]], an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] head [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], wore a patterned [[Clothing/Legends|blue]] [[Shimmerbird tongue robe/Legends|robe]] made of shimmerbird tongues.<ref name="AOTCVD" />
